text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The department of national parks and wildlife management has introduced strict new measures to make it impossible to sell poached ivory in Zimbabwe.
- The National Employment Council for the Clothing Industry on Tuesday urged striking employees to return to work or risk being dismissed.
- A proposed merger between the Confederation of Zimbabwe Industries and the Zimbabwe National Chamber of Commerce has been called off, just six months before the scheduled completion of the deal.
